easyPrerequisites: You've cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn.
description:
Activate Sanar, Unfinished Genius // Wild Idea by tapping it, creating an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters, Fateful Discovery triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Sanar, Unfinished Genius // Wild Idea.
Repeat.
